svg.title: Allocate $8,000–$45,000 Without Funding Claims
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-capital-allocation; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Allocate $8,000–$45,000 Without Funding Claims; subtitle: Four buckets compare lean, working, and expanded launch budgets.; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Numeric values represent a $25,000 working launch budget. Each stage also supplies lean and expanded allocations; their totals are $8,000 and $45,000 respectively. These are capital budgets, not annual revenue or recurring expense totals.; caption: Working allocation totals $6,000 + $6,500 + $4,500 + $8,000 = $25,000. Liquidity supports the 2–5 month first-deal window; none of these buckets capitalizes employer claim liabilities.; stages: label: Licensing, contracts, and coverage; value: Lean $2,000 / Working $6,000 / Expanded $9,000; numeric value: 6000.0; detail: Fund required licensing work, professional liability and cyber coverage deposits, service agreements, and compensation disclosure templates. The lean allocation assumes existing relevant licenses and a tightly limited initial service scope.; label: Secure analysis infrastructure; value: Lean $1,500 / Working $6,500 / Expanded $11,000; numeric value: 6500.0; detail: Provision encrypted storage, multifactor authentication, role-based access, logging, secure transfer, and claims normalization. Use public CMS benchmarks and DOL filings without assuming all required contract records are public.; label: Account acquisition and proposals; value: Lean $1,500 / Working $4,500 / Expanded $8,000; numeric value: 4500.0; detail: Build a verified renewal list, referral materials, discovery scripts, and evidence-backed proposals. Track cost per completed discovery rather than celebrating unqualified contact counts or speculative recoveries.; label: Operating liquidity reserve; value: Lean $3,000 / Working $8,000 / Expanded $17,000; numeric value: 8000.0; detail: Bridge recurring cash expenses and collection delays. At $2,000 monthly opex, reserves cover 1.5, 4, and 8.5 months respectively; at $11,000, they cover about 0.27, 0.73, and 1.55 months. Reconcile spending to runway.

rect.title: label: Licensing, contracts, and coverage; numeric value: 6000.0; value: Lean $2,000 / Working $6,000 / Expanded $9,000; detail: Fund required licensing work, professional liability and cyber coverage deposits, service agreements, and compensation disclosure templates. The lean allocation assumes existing relevant licenses and a tightly limited initial service scope.

text.title: Licensing, contracts, and coverage: Lean $2,000 / Working $6,000 / Expanded $9,000
text.tspan: Licensing, contracts, and coverage: Lean $2,000 / Working $6,000 / Expanded $9,000

rect.title: label: Secure analysis infrastructure; numeric value: 6500.0; value: Lean $1,500 / Working $6,500 / Expanded $11,000; detail: Provision encrypted storage, multifactor authentication, role-based access, logging, secure transfer, and claims normalization. Use public CMS benchmarks and DOL filings without assuming all required contract records are public.

text.title: Secure analysis infrastructure: Lean $1,500 / Working $6,500 / Expanded $11,000
text.tspan: Secure analysis infrastructure: Lean $1,500 / Working $6,500 / Expanded $11,000

rect.title: label: Account acquisition and proposals; numeric value: 4500.0; value: Lean $1,500 / Working $4,500 / Expanded $8,000; detail: Build a verified renewal list, referral materials, discovery scripts, and evidence-backed proposals. Track cost per completed discovery rather than celebrating unqualified contact counts or speculative recoveries.

text.title: Account acquisition and proposals: Lean $1,500 / Working $4,500 / Expanded $8,000
text.tspan: Account acquisition and proposals: Lean $1,500 / Working $4,500 / Expanded $8,000

rect.title: label: Operating liquidity reserve; numeric value: 8000.0; value: Lean $3,000 / Working $8,000 / Expanded $17,000; detail: Bridge recurring cash expenses and collection delays. At $2,000 monthly opex, reserves cover 1.5, 4, and 8.5 months respectively; at $11,000, they cover about 0.27, 0.73, and 1.55 months. Reconcile spending to runway.

text.title: Operating liquidity reserve: Lean $3,000 / Working $8,000 / Expanded $17,000
text.tspan: Operating liquidity reserve: Lean $3,000 / Working $8,000 / Expanded $17,000

text.title: Assumptions: Numeric values represent a $25,000 working launch budget. Each stage also supplies lean and expanded allocations; their totals are $8,000 and $45,000 respectively. These are capital budgets, not annual revenue or recurring expense totals.
